# tritonctl project

The projects of your tenant, and their quotas

Subcommands: list, show, create, delete, quota

Usage: `tritonctl project [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl project list

List the projects of your tenant

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl project list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl project show

Show one project. Defaults to the one you work in

Usage: `tritonctl project show [OPTIONS] [ID]`

- `<ID>`: Project name, uuid, or prefix

## tritonctl project create

Create a project in your tenant

Usage: `tritonctl project create [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>`

- `--name <NAME>` (required)
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`

## tritonctl project delete

Delete a project. What it holds is not deleted with it: delete the instances and networks first

Alias: rm

Usage: `tritonctl project delete [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Project name, uuid, or prefix
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails

## tritonctl project quota

The limits a project may use. Defaults to the one you work in

Usage: `tritonctl project quota [OPTIONS] [ID]`

- `<ID>`: Project name, uuid, or prefix
